content: AutoField.get_pk_value_on_save is not overridden, so it returns None. In `_save_table`, when `pk_val is None`, `setattr(self, meta.pk.attname, pk_val)` sets uid=None; `pk_set=False`; save goes through force_insert path; fields list excludes `meta.auto_field`; INSERT passed without uid; DB generates value. After INSERT, returning_fields loop is empty so no setattr. But test observed uid=1 after save, so something else must set it—need to debug with print statements to trace the actual assignment.
